caption:
Cheap leads are the easiest thing to buy and the most expensive thing to own.

I can get your cost per lead down tomorrow. Give away something nobody has to think about, remove the qualifying questions, run it broad, and watch the number drop. You'll be delighted for about three weeks.

Then someone has to call those people. And they didn't ask for a call, don't remember filling it in, and aren't buying. The cost moved — out of the ad account and into your calendar, where it doesn't show up on any report.

A lead at R$8 that never closes is infinitely more expensive than a lead at R$60 that does, and the number everybody optimises is the first one.

Track one metric down the funnel: cost per client. If your agency can't show it, they aren't optimising your business. They're optimising their screenshot.
